summary: Department owners can confirm, extend or ask to remove their people's access, with an optional regular review by mail.

new.title: Keep, Extend or Remove on My people
new.text: Department owners can confirm a person's access, extend it, or request its removal on My people. A PIM administrator approves removals, and the page shows who is due for review.

new.title: A regular owner review by mail
new.text: The new owner review job mails each department's owners their people with a link to My people. Turn it on under Jobs; it runs every 90 days by default.
